Abstract
Diffusion models have recently advanced video restora-
tion, but applying them to real-world and AIGC-generated
video super-resolution (VSR) remains challenging due to
high latency, prohibitive computation, and poor general-
ization to ultra-high resolutions. Our goal in this work
is to make diffusion-based VSR practical by achieving ef-
ficiency, scalability, and near real-time performance. To
this end, we proposeFlashVSR, the first diffusion-based
one-step streaming framework for efficient video super-
